scope: Real pinned local image model inference core and worker; not yet connected to chat media gates
implemented: Vendored NSFWJS MobileNetV2 model.json, quantized weights and unchanged upstream MIT license from commit d55a54c51f14380670064cc129b2ea51029c5e46. Provenance includes exact byte counts, SHA-256 hashes, class order, preprocessing and limitations. No dependency was added; existing TensorFlow.js is reused.

Actual TensorFlow LayersModel loading verifies pinned manifest and weight sizes/hashes before deserialization. CPU execution is intended only in a dedicated worker, not the microphone/main-thread TensorFlow runtime.

Inference normalizes RGB to 0..1, uses TensorFlow bilinear 224x224 alignCorners=true, validates all five output probabilities and disposes prediction tensors. Sexual content output is positive/negative/uncertain; disturbing content is ALWAYS unknown because this model cannot classify violence/gore.

Worker accepts bounded raster blobs, decodes away from the UI, bounds pixel count, serializes jobs and returns generic errors without media/filename/exception text. Model fetches are same-origin with no credentials or redirects, bounded timeouts and exact-size streaming reads; no third-party runtime model service is used.
Container checks reject GIF/video, unsupported types, animated PNG/WebP and malformed chunk lengths before decoding. A single static frame is never treated as the verdict for an animation.

verification.detail: Loads actual pinned weights and executes three synthetic RGB inputs on CPU; verifies finite outputs, disturbing unknown, stable tensor count, corrupt asset rejection, malformed score/shape rejection and animation-container checks. Synthetic inputs do not establish classifier accuracy.
Includes exact-size asset streaming and oversized-body cancellation tests.
